title: Nash Equilibrium via Kakutani Fixed Point (OQ-04-OQ-01)
description: Proves Nash equilibrium existence for finite N-player normal-form games via Kakutani's fixed point theorem. Defines expected utility, best response correspondence, proves best response nonemptiness (EVT), convexity (multilinearity), and closedness. Nash existence follows from Kakutani applied to the joint best response map. Imports BrouwerFixedPointOQ04 (2 axioms) + 2 own = 4 total axioms.
